data.long_meaning: The name Asmar is derived from the Arabic language and is used predominantly in the Islamic world. It is a name of Arabic origin and is a common name for boys. The name Asmar is derived from the Arabic word ‘asmar’ which means ‘black’ or ‘dark’. In Islamic culture, the color black is often associated with wisdom, power, and protection. In the Quran, Allah says, ‘Verily, with the hardship, there is relief,’ (Al-Inshirah 94:5-6). This verse is often interpreted to mean that even in the darkest of times, there is a light to guide us. The name Asmar is a reminder of this divine guidance and the wisdom and strength that comes from faith.
